title: Spyro Gyra Breakout CD 1986 MCA Records Made in Japan Smooth Jazz Fusion
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Spyro Gyra - Breakout (MCA Records MCAD-5753, 1986). JVC-507.
Compact disc made in Japan. Manufactured for RCA Direct Marketing under
license. Produced by Jay Beckenstein and Richard Calandra for
Crosseyed Bear Productions; assistant producer Jeremy Wall.

1. Bob Goes To The Store (4:36)
2. Freefall (4:52)
3. Doubletake (4:05)
4. Breakout (4:37)
5. Body Wave (4:09)
6. Whirlwind (5:37)
7. Swept Away (5:43)
8. Guiltless (5:10)

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
